service.description: The jobs of the working tree's ci.xml (or why there are none: no file, an error with its line): each pipeline, job, image, its matrix combinations (matrixKeys, and combinations: each with its steps, variables, the script it runs whole and that script's digest), and the secrets it asks for, which a local run does not have.

Run one job (pipeline, job, matrixKey: one combination of a matrix job, the first by default) of the working tree's ci.xml in a new host session of the Terminal, in the working tree: its steps in order as the job runs them (sh -c each, stopping at one that fails unless continue-on-error), with its variables and CI's own, and its secrets' variables unset, only when the script is the one get#LocalJobs showed (its digest). The script is the server user's alone (0600 in a 0700 directory) and removes itself when it ends; it is typed into the server user's shell. Not the job's image. From a session only.

parameter.name: digest
parameter.description: The digest of the script get#LocalJobs showed: a script rebuilt to something else (ci.xml changed since) is refused
